notes.title: New Update Streamers
notes.notes:
Hello Streamers 

As we move forward with the game, we have been moving forward with new updates. Like today's now all players can expect more from the ghost. 


 New Jump Scares 


 Ghosts Have Foot Steps When Hunting 


 NVG system On Camera Now Works even after a hunt 


Fixes 
Fixed the ghost colliders so ghosts could move more
Fixed some small bugs 

Remember, streamers, if you have any problems, let us know so we can address them here, in discussions.

Again thank you, streamers, for your support and happy influencing.

notes.title: Major Update Notes
notes.notes:
Major Update V3.26

We heard you guys, based on the feedback we are made some adjustments in the game.

1.Improved graphics
2.Fixed some bugs.
3.Made less servers.
4.Removed character customization for now, will be available in few days.
5.Made tutorial room where you can learn about game functions.
